blocks.title: Aurora
blocks.description: Soft waving aurora bands over a night sky; calm, premium background.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; colors?: string[]; sky?: [string,string]; speed?: number /*1*/; intensity?: number /*0.7*/}

blocks.title: Gradient mesh
blocks.description: Modern slowly drifting multi-colour gradient background; use behind titles and UI.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; colors?: string[]; background?: string; speed?: number /*1*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: Particle field
blocks.description: Seeded drifting dots with optional connecting lines; use for tech, network and data themes.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; count?: number /*60*/; connect?: boolean /*true*/; linkDistance?: number /*180*/; color?: string; background?: string; speed?: number /*25*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: Perspective grid
blocks.description: Retro synthwave 3D grid floor scrolling toward the viewer; use for tech, gaming and 80s themes.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; lineColor?: string; sky?: [string,string]; cell?: number /*90*/; speed?: number /*120*/; horizon?: number /*0.5*/}

blocks.title: Caption boxed
blocks.description: Use for clean, professional captions on a rounded dark panel with the spoken word on an accent chip (explainers, interviews). The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
blocks.props: {captions: Caption[]; maxWordsPerPage?: number /*5*/; boxColor?: string; color?: string; chipColor?: string /*'#3b82f6'*/; fontSize?: number; fontFamily?: string /*'Inter, sans-serif'*/}

blocks.title: Caption karaoke
blocks.description: Use for word-by-word spoken captions where each word fills with colour as it is said (talking heads, voice-overs). The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
blocks.props: {captions: Caption[]; maxWordsPerPage?: number /*4*/; color?: string; highlightColor?: string /*'#ffd54a'*/; fontSize?: number; fontFamily?: string /*'Montserrat, sans-serif'*/}

blocks.title: Caption outline bold
blocks.description: Use for bold upper-case captions with a thick outline that stay readable over busy footage; the spoken word changes colour. The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
blocks.props: {captions: Caption[]; maxWordsPerPage?: number /*3*/; color?: string; activeColor?: string /*'#ffe14d'*/; outlineColor?: string /*'#000'*/; fontSize?: number; fontFamily?: string /*'Anton, sans-serif'*/}

blocks.title: Caption pop word
blocks.description: Use for punchy short-form captions that show one big word at a time, popping in as it is spoken. The `captions` prop is a @remotion/captions Caption[].
blocks.props: {captions: Caption[]; color?: string; accentColor?: string /*'#ff4d6d'*/; fontSize?: number; uppercase?: boolean /*true*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Anton, sans-serif'*/}

blocks.title: Bar chart
blocks.description: Use to compare a handful of categories: horizontal bars grow in one after another with value labels. Transparent overlay with light text by default (theme 'dark'): put it on a dark backdrop, or pass theme="light" for light backdrops.
blocks.props: {data: {label: string; value: number}[]; title?: string; color?: string /*'#38bdf8'*/; valueFormat?: string /*',.0f'*/; startFrame?: number /*5*/; staggerFrames?: number /*6*/; fontFamily?: string; textColor?: string; theme?: 'dark'|'light' /*'dark'*/}
blocks.example:
import {ChartBars} from './blocks/chart-bars/ChartBars.tsx';
<ChartBars title="Users by region" data={[{label: "Europe", value: 420}, {label: "Asia", value: 610}]} />

blocks.title: Donut chart
blocks.description: Use to show parts of a whole (shares, budget split): a donut that sweeps open with a total and a legend. Transparent overlay with light text by default (theme 'dark'): put it on a dark backdrop, or pass theme="light" for light backdrops.
blocks.props: {data: {label: string; value: number; color?: string}[]; centerLabel?: string /*'Total'*/; palette?: string[]; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*45*/; fontFamily?: string; textColor?: string; theme?: 'dark'|'light' /*'dark'*/}

blocks.title: Line chart draw-on
blocks.description: Use to show a trend over time: a smooth line with area fill that draws itself left to right. Transparent overlay with light text by default (theme 'dark'): put it on a dark backdrop, or pass theme="light" for light backdrops.
blocks.props: {values: number[]; labels?: string[]; title?: string; color?: string /*'#34d399'*/; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*50*/; fontFamily?: string; textColor?: string; theme?: 'dark'|'light' /*'dark'*/}

blocks.title: KPI ticker
blocks.description: Use to land one headline number: a big figure that counts up with a label and an optional change chip. The figure size fits the frame width (9:16 safe); override with fontSize.
blocks.props: {value: number; label: string; from?: number /*0*/; prefix?: string; suffix?: string; valueFormat?: string /*',.0f'*/; delta?: string; deltaColor?: string /*'#34d399'*/; color?: string; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*40*/; fontSize?: number /*fits width*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Space Grotesk, sans-serif'*/}
blocks.example:
import {KpiTicker} from './blocks/kpi-ticker/KpiTicker.tsx';
<KpiTicker value={128400} prefix="$" label="Monthly revenue" delta="+12.4%" />

blocks.title: Progress ring
blocks.description: Use to show completion or a score out of 100: a ring that fills while the percentage counts up.
blocks.props: {percent: number; label?: string; color?: string /*'#22d3ee'*/; trackColor?: string; textColor?: string; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*45*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Space Grotesk, sans-serif'*/}

blocks.title: Sparkline card
blocks.description: Use for a small trend callout next to a metric: a compact card with the latest value and a self-drawing line.
blocks.props: {values: number[]; label?: string; valueFormat?: string /*',.0f'*/; color?: string /*'#f472b6'*/; textColor?: string; cardColor?: string; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*40*/; fontFamily?: string}

blocks.title: Browser frame
blocks.description: Put screenshots or UI inside a browser window with chrome; use for web product demos.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; url?: string; title?: string; width?: number /*1400*/; height?: number /*800*/; dark?: boolean; font?: string /*"Inter"*/}

blocks.title: Cursor click
blocks.description: Animated mouse cursor that glides to a point and clicks with a ripple; use to guide attention in UI demos.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; from?: [number,number]; to?: [number,number]; startFrame?: number /*5*/; moveFrames?: number /*30*/; rippleColor?: string; scale?: number /*1.6*/}

blocks.title: Laptop frame
blocks.description: Put a desktop UI inside a laptop with base; use for SaaS and software showcases.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; width?: number /*1200*/; body?: string}

blocks.title: Phone frame
blocks.description: Put app screens or vertical video inside a smartphone bezel; use for mobile demos.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; width?: number /*400*/; bezel?: string; rotate?: number /*0*/}

blocks.title: Toast notification
blocks.description: Notification card that slides in, holds and slides out; use for success messages and alerts in UI scenes.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; title?: string; message?: string; startFrame?: number /*10*/; holdFrames?: number /*60*/; position?: "top-right"|"top-left"|"bottom-right"|"bottom-left"; accent?: string; font?: string}
blocks.example:
import {ToastNotification} from './blocks/toast-notification/ToastNotification.tsx';
<ToastNotification title="Saved" message="All changes synced" />

blocks.title: Bokeh
blocks.description: Floating soft light circles for a dreamy depth-of-field feel over a scene.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; count?: number /*18*/; intensity?: number /*0.6*/; colors?: string[]; maxSize?: number /*220*/; speed?: number /*30*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: Confetti
blocks.description: Seeded confetti burst for celebrations and milestones.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; count?: number /*90*/; origin?: [number,number] /*[0.5,0.6]*/; colors?: string[]; power?: number /*1400*/; durationInFrames?: number /*90*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: CRT scanlines
blocks.description: Wrap a scene in an old CRT monitor look: scanlines, rounded screen, vignette and flicker. Use for retro or gaming moments.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; intensity?: number /*0.5*/; lineHeight?: number /*4*/; curvature?: number /*40*/; flicker?: number /*0.4*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: Film grain
blocks.description: Overlay animated film grain on any scene for a filmic, analogue texture.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; intensity?: number /*0.35*/; frequency?: number /*0.8*/; holdFrames?: number /*2*/}

blocks.title: Halftone
blocks.description: Use for a comic or print halftone dot look over a scene, strongest at the edges (stylised intros, comic-book beats). Render cost: masks and rotates a full-frame layer, about +0.36 s/frame at 1080p (roughly 5 minutes extra for a 30 s film), so apply it to short beats, not whole films.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; dotSize?: number /*18*/; color?: string; intensity?: number /*0.5*/; angle?: number /*45*/; drift?: number /*12*/; clearCenter?: number /*25*/}

blocks.title: Light leak
blocks.description: Warm drifting light leaks blended over a scene for a nostalgic film feel, good for transitions and intros.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; intensity?: number /*0.7*/; colors?: string[]; speed?: number /*1*/}

blocks.title: VHS glitch
blocks.description: Glitch a scene with RGB channel split and horizontal tear bands in seeded bursts. Use for tension cuts or retro intros.
blocks.props: {children: ReactNode; intensity?: number /*0.5*/; split?: number /*14*/; bands?: number /*3*/; stepFrames?: number /*3*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: Vignette
blocks.description: Darken or tint the edges to focus attention on the centre of a scene.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; intensity?: number /*0.6*/; innerStop?: number /*45*/; color?: string /*"#000"*/; pulse?: number /*0*/; pulseFrames?: number /*90*/}

blocks.title: Map pin pulse
blocks.description: Use to mark places on a world map: pins drop in and send out pulsing rings with city labels (offline).
blocks.props: {pins?: {name: string; lon: number; lat: number}[] /*London, New York, Tokyo*/; landColor?: string; strokeColor?: string; pinColor?: string /*'#f43f5e'*/; textColor?: string; staggerFrames?: number /*10*/; fontFamily?: string}

blocks.title: Map region highlight
blocks.description: Use to call out a country by ISO code on a world map: it lights up and the camera eases toward it (offline). The label sits on the country.
blocks.props: {code?: string /*'ITA' (ISO alpha-3 or alpha-2)*/; label?: string /*country name*/; zoom?: number /*0.5*/; landColor?: string; strokeColor?: string; highlightColor?: string /*'#38bdf8'*/; textColor?: string; startFrame?: number /*10*/; durationInFrames?: number /*40*/; fontFamily?: string}

blocks.title: Map route arc
blocks.description: Use to show a journey or shipment between two cities: a great-circle route draws on with a travelling dot (offline).
blocks.props: {from?: City /*Lisbon*/; to?: City /*Sao Paulo*/; landColor?: string; strokeColor?: string; routeColor?: string /*'#fbbf24'*/; textColor?: string; startFrame?: number /*12*/; durationInFrames?: number /*45*/; fontFamily?: string} // City = {name: string; lon: number; lat: number}
blocks.example:
import {MapRouteArc} from './blocks/map-route-arc/MapRouteArc.tsx';
<MapRouteArc from={{name: "Paris", lon: 2.35, lat: 48.86}} to={{name: "Tokyo", lon: 139.7, lat: 35.7}} />

blocks.title: Arrow draw
blocks.description: Hand-drawn style arrow that draws itself along given points; use to point at something on screen.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; points?: [number,number][]; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*30*/; color?: string; strokeWidth?: number /*10*/; wobble?: number /*4*/; seed?: string}

blocks.title: Callout bubble
blocks.description: Speech or annotation bubble with a pointer that pops in; use to label or comment on part of the frame.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; text?: string; position?: [number,number]; pointer?: "bottom-left"|"bottom-right"|"top-left"|"top-right"; startFrame?: number /*5*/; background?: string; color?: string; fontSize?: number /*44*/; font?: string}

blocks.title: Check draw
blocks.description: Animated checkmark inside a circle that draws itself; use for success, done and completed states.
blocks.props: {children?: ReactNode; size?: number /*360*/; startFrame?: number /*5*/; durationInFrames?: number /*36*/; color?: string; strokeWidth?: number /*18*/; fill?: boolean}

blocks.title: Character stagger
blocks.description: Letters pop in one by one with a springy overshoot; use for playful or punchy short titles.
blocks.props: {text: string; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; fontSize?: number /*110*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Space Grotesk, sans-serif'*/; fontWeight?: number /*700*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; staggerFrames?: number /*2*/}

blocks.title: Counter number
blocks.description: Big number that counts to a target with a label; use for stats, milestones and KPIs.
blocks.props: {from?: number /*0*/; to?: number /*12840*/; prefix?: string; suffix?: string; label?: string; decimals?: number /*0*/; color?: string; labelColor?: string; fontSize?: number /*180*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Space Grotesk, sans-serif'*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*45*/}

blocks.title: GSAP kinetic title
blocks.description: Title whose characters rise in with a GSAP SplitText timeline. The timeline is built paused and sought from the frame, so every frame is deterministic.
blocks.props: {text: string; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; fontSize?: number /*120*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Inter, sans-serif'*/; staggerSeconds?: number /*0.03*/; durationSeconds?: number /*0.6*/}
blocks.example:
import {GsapKineticTitle} from './blocks/gsap-kinetic-title/GsapKineticTitle.tsx';
<GsapKineticTitle text="Ship the cut today" color="#fff" fontSize={110} />

blocks.title: Kinetic title
blocks.description: Centered title that lands word by word: each word rises and fades in on a spring, staggered by a few frames.
blocks.props: {text: string; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; fontSize?: number /*120*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Inter, sans-serif'*/; staggerFrames?: number /*5*/}
blocks.example:
import {KineticTitle} from './blocks/kinetic-title/KineticTitle.tsx';
<KineticTitle text="Ship the cut today" color="#fff" fontSize={110} />

blocks.title: Lower third: bar
blocks.description: Solid name bar with an accent stripe in the lower left; use to introduce a speaker or place.
blocks.props: {name: string; subtitle?: string; accentColor?: string /*'#f43f5e'*/; barColor?: string /*'#0f172a'*/; textColor?: string; fontFamily?: string /*'Montserrat, sans-serif'*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; endFrame?: number}
blocks.example:
import {LowerThirdBar} from './blocks/lower-third-bar/LowerThirdBar.tsx';
<LowerThirdBar name="Ada Lovelace" subtitle="Founder, Analytical Co." />

blocks.title: Lower third: glass
blocks.description: Frosted translucent name card that floats up in the lower left; use over busy footage or imagery.
blocks.props: {name: string; subtitle?: string; accentColor?: string /*'#38bdf8'*/; textColor?: string; fontFamily?: string /*'DM Sans, sans-serif'*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; endFrame?: number}
blocks.example:
import {LowerThirdGlass} from './blocks/lower-third-glass/LowerThirdGlass.tsx';
<LowerThirdGlass name="Ada Lovelace" subtitle="Founder, Analytical Co." />

blocks.title: Lower third: minimal
blocks.description: Text only over a thin drawn line; use for clean, documentary-style credits.
blocks.props: {name: string; subtitle?: string; lineColor?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; textColor?: string; fontFamily?: string /*'Inter, sans-serif'*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; endFrame?: number}
blocks.example:
import {LowerThirdMinimal} from './blocks/lower-third-minimal/LowerThirdMinimal.tsx';
<LowerThirdMinimal name="Ada Lovelace" subtitle="Founder, Analytical Co." />

blocks.title: Marquee ticker
blocks.description: Endless scrolling news-style band of text; use for headlines, announcements or promo strips.
blocks.props: {items?: string[]; backgroundColor?: string /*'#facc15'*/; color?: string; fontSize?: number /*56*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Bebas Neue, sans-serif'*/; speed?: number /*8, px per frame*/; itemsPerView?: number /*2*/; position?: 'bottom'|'middle' /*'bottom'*/}
blocks.example:
import {MarqueeTicker} from './blocks/marquee-ticker/MarqueeTicker.tsx';
<MarqueeTicker items={["\u2022 BREAKING NEWS", "\u2022 FRESH TEMPLATES"]} speed={8} />

blocks.title: Text mask reveal
blocks.description: Huge letters filled with a drifting gradient, wiped in from the left; use for bold opening titles.
blocks.props: {text: string; colors?: string[]; fontSize?: number /*140*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Anton, sans-serif'*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*24*/}

blocks.title: Typewriter with cursor
blocks.description: Text types out behind a blinking cursor; use for code, terminals, quotes and reveals of a sentence.
blocks.props: {text: string; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; cursorColor?: string /*'#38bdf8'*/; fontSize?: number /*64*/; fontFamily?: string /*'JetBrains Mono, monospace'*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; charsPerSecond?: number /*18*/; blinkFrames?: number /*16*/}

blocks.title: Word reveal
blocks.description: Words rise out of a mask one after another; use for headlines and key statements.
blocks.props: {text: string; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/; fontSize?: number /*80*/; fontFamily?: string /*'Montserrat, sans-serif'*/; fontWeight?: number /*800*/; startFrame?: number /*0*/; staggerFrames?: number /*4*/}
blocks.example:
import {WordReveal} from './blocks/word-reveal/WordReveal.tsx';
<WordReveal text="Make every frame count" />

blocks.title: Flash cut
blocks.description: Hard cut hidden behind a quick colour flash; use for beats, impacts and camera-flash moments.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*10*/; color?: string /*'#ffffff'*/}
blocks.example:
import {FlashCut} from './blocks/flash-cut/FlashCut.tsx';
<FlashCut from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} color="#ffffff" />

blocks.title: Glitch cut
blocks.description: Scene change through jittering horizontal slices (slices is clamped to 2-24); use for tech, gaming or error-themed cuts.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*14*/; slices?: number /*8*/; intensity?: number /*90*/; seed?: string /*'glitch'*/}
blocks.example:
import {GlitchCut} from './blocks/glitch-cut/GlitchCut.tsx';
<GlitchCut from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} slices={8} intensity={90} />

blocks.title: Ink reveal
blocks.description: New scene spreads from a point through an organic wobbling clip-path; use for soft, artistic reveals.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*28*/; originX?: number /*50*/; originY?: number /*50*/; roughness?: number /*0.5*/; seed?: string /*'ink'*/}
blocks.example:
import {InkReveal} from './blocks/ink-reveal/InkReveal.tsx';
<InkReveal from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} originX={50} originY={50} roughness={0.5} />

blocks.title: Whip blur
blocks.description: Fast whip pan between scenes with motion blur; use for quick travel or high-energy cuts.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*14*/; direction?: 'left'|'right' /*'left'*/; maxBlur?: number /*28*/}
blocks.example:
import {WhipBlur} from './blocks/whip-blur/WhipBlur.tsx';
<WhipBlur from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} direction="left" maxBlur={28} />

blocks.title: Wipe edges
blocks.description: Wipe between two scenes with a coloured bar riding the moving edge; use for energetic section changes.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*20*/; direction?: 'left'|'right' /*'left'*/; edgeColor?: string /*'#facc15'*/; edgeWidth?: number /*24*/}
blocks.example:
import {WipeEdges} from './blocks/wipe-edges/WipeEdges.tsx';
<WipeEdges from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} direction="left" edgeColor="#facc15" />

blocks.title: Wipe slide
blocks.description: Directional wipe from one scene to the next: the arriving scene is revealed by a moving clip-path edge with an ease-in-out curve.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*20*/; direction?: 'left'|'right'|'up'|'down' /*'left'*/}
blocks.example:
import {WipeSlide} from './blocks/wipe-slide/WipeSlide.tsx';
<WipeSlide from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} durationInFrames={20} direction="left" />

blocks.title: Zoom through
blocks.description: Old scene zooms past the camera while the new one settles in; use to dive into a new topic or detail.
blocks.props: {from: ReactNode; to: ReactNode; startFrame?: number /*0*/; durationInFrames?: number /*20*/; zoom?: number /*3*/; maxBlur?: number /*12*/}
blocks.example:
import {ZoomThrough} from './blocks/zoom-through/ZoomThrough.tsx';
<ZoomThrough from={<SceneA />} to={<SceneB />} startFrame={40} zoom={3} />
